comment: No source is published. The nine note values run 8 beats down to a thirty-second of one, displayed as 2/1 through 1/128. Scatter sets the grain launch spacing to the grain length divided by two times 4 to the power of the knob, and the random throw to 0.18 of a second times the knob. The frequency shift is the knob in semitones divided by 12 and multiplied by the Max shift figure, so the marking in semitones is a scale on a linear shift rather than a transposition. The four menu figures start at 50ms grain, 0.5 seconds base time, 20ms crossfade and 1000Hz maximum shift. There is a tenth parameter, index 4, that the maker calls Feel: it multiplies the delay by 2/3 for Triplet or 1.5 for Dotted, but neither panel SVG carries the feel-switch element the widget looks for and the context menu does not offer it, so it has no widget position, cannot be clicked or turned, and is stuck on Straight. It gets no line and no tag. The sumRange spelling of the feedback clamp is written as a voltage because the field takes no other shape; the quantity itself is a gain, not a voltage. Nothing in the plugin reads a channel count, so every port is mono. The panel menu also carries Reload panel and Poll SVG for reload, which every module in this plugin has and which only reload the panel artwork; they are left out.
